intelligence.human_view: Think of each day as a little black jewel on the month — a black square in the middle, its rim lit up in that day's own color, so the whole month glows in the colors of the week. Inside the jewel: the number, big; the wisdom of that day, the quote; and a button that says VIEW. Tap the jewel or tap VIEW and the whole screen becomes that day — your daily cockpit, everything going on in your world for that day, the menu to click through it all. And the calendar runs both ways: backwards, to any day you ever lived, and forwards — someone comes to your calendar and books an appointment with you in a day that hasn't happened yet. Each day even hums at its own frequency — Monday 417, Tuesday 528, all the way round to Sunday 963 — shown in the day view. And the weather shows only when we actually know where they live; when we don't know, nothing is invented. A day you can't see the weather for is honest; a day with invented weather is a lie.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the month is a box of glowing jewels — each day a shiny BLACK square with its edges lit up in its own color! Inside each one: the big number, a wise little quote, and a button that says VIEW! You tap it and BOOM — the whole screen becomes that day, like the cockpit of a spaceship, with everything going on in your world! And you can go BACK to any day, or FORWARD — someone can even come and book a time with you! Each day has its own special hum — Monday goes 417! And the weather only shows if we really know where you live — never made up!

The day view is the DAILY COCKPIT. Mobile: number + View always, wisdom where it fits.
